    Finite quivers, path algebras and representations #

    A finite quiver Q, its path algebra kQ and the representations of Q (of arbitrary dimension), with the manuscript's conventions: modules are left modules, so representations are covariant, and for arrows α : i → j and β : j → l the product βα traverses α first.

    FinQuiver and the presentation of kQ as a RingQuot of a free algebra are adapted from BrickAccessibility/Statement.lean in brick-accessibility-special-biserial (commit efae161c558e7545419580026e7e6f3447d1bc4a), which uses traversal-order products for right modules; here the source and target relations are swapped.

        source
        inductive LargeIndecomposable.FinQuiver.PathRel (k : Type u) [Field k] (Q : FinQuiver) :
        FreeAlgebra k Q.Gen → FreeAlgebra k Q.Gen → Prop

        The defining relations of the path algebra (left-module convention): the vertex idempotents are orthogonal and sum to one, and an arrow c satisfies c e_{s(c)} = c = e_{t(c)} c.

        • idem {k : Type u} [Field k] {Q : FinQuiver} (v w : Q.V) : PathRel k Q (FreeAlgebra.ι k (Sum.inl v) * FreeAlgebra.ι k (Sum.inl w)) (if v = w then FreeAlgebra.ι k (Sum.inl v) else 0)
        • one {k : Type u} [Field k] {Q : FinQuiver} : PathRel k Q (∑ v : Q.V, FreeAlgebra.ι k (Sum.inl v)) 1
        • src {k : Type u} [Field k] {Q : FinQuiver} (a : Q.A) : PathRel k Q (FreeAlgebra.ι k (Sum.inr a) * FreeAlgebra.ι k (Sum.inl (Q.src a))) (FreeAlgebra.ι k (Sum.inr a))
        • tgt {k : Type u} [Field k] {Q : FinQuiver} (a : Q.A) : PathRel k Q (FreeAlgebra.ι k (Sum.inl (Q.tgt a)) * FreeAlgebra.ι k (Sum.inr a)) (FreeAlgebra.ι k (Sum.inr a))
